candidates.term: The Artisan inside the Hour Gate
candidates.defline: The Artisan lives inside your Hour Gate: your harvest is children, comfort, and a well-fed old age.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Health at the root of late life. This is a blessed seat: children who stay warm toward you, appetites that survive age, an ending with flavor in it. It rewards early tending, the health kept now, the young fed patiently, the pleasures practiced rather than postponed. Build the orchard in your forties. This root intends you to sit in its shade, tasting what you planted.
